webster.text: The act of disputing; a reasoning or argumentation in opposition to something, or on opposite sides; controversy in words; verbal contest, respecting the truth of some fact, opinion, proposition or argument.

more.text: An exercise in colleges, in which parties reason in opposition to each other, on some question proposed.

example.quote: Let the public disputations become researches into the grounds and nature and ends of government, and the means of preserving the good and demolishing the evil.
example.cite: John Adams, A Dissertation on the Canon and the Feudal Law (1765)
